Method of Attack: Preinstalled inside pirated WordPress premium themes
Adds a secret admin user '100010010' as a backdoor to the site's backend
Allows attackers to open connections to infected websites for scripted attacks
Injects spam on infected sites to propagate malware and expand hacked site network
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using nulled (pirated) premium themes
Attack Vector: Nulled WordPress premium themes downloaded from sites offering pirated scripts, themes, and plugins
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of secret admin user with username '100010010'
Modified files functions.php and class.theme-modules.php with recent modification dates
functions.php containing specific malicious code line at the top
class.theme-modules.php containing large Base64-encoded text block at the top
